question: Which billing cycles and prices does the lisahost WHMCS cart offer for the US CN2 GIA basic plan (pid 7) once it returns to stock?
why: the cart refuses the plan and the trial as out of stock on 2026-11-07, so no cycle list or cart price is readable; the cart-side group page prices only the quarterly term (CNY 122.00) and the homepage only the monthly term (CNY 35). An account or a restocked cart would settle the cycle ladder and the renewal price.
